business_summary: Nanjing Pharmaceutical Group Company Limited engages in the distribution of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and health products in China. It also involved in the wholesale and retail of pharmaceuticals; provision of internet + Chinese medicine pharmacy service platform; and pharmaceutical third-party logistics services. The company was formerly known as NanJing Pharmaceutical Company Limited and change its name to Nanjing Pharmaceutical Group Company Limited in December 2025. Nanjing Pharmaceutical Group Company Limited was founded in 1951 and is based in Nanjing, China.
business_summary_ko: Nanjing Pharmaceutical Group Company Limited는 중국에서 의약품, 의료기기, 건강제품 유통에 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 의약품 도매 및 소매업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 인터넷 + 한약약국 서비스 플랫폼 제공; 제약 제3자 물류 서비스. 이 회사는 이전에 NanJing Pharmaceutical Company Limited로 알려졌으나 2025년 12월에 Nanjing Pharmaceutical Group Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Nanjing Pharmaceutical Group Company Limited는 1951년에 설립되었으며 중국 난징에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
